unknown_heads: PROTECT every Active second distinct from the UNKNOWN head and every remaining Active Third.
unknown_seconds: Under every known-front or UNKNOWN head, PROTECT an UNKNOWN second and every remaining Active Third.

rollback: Remove the explicit research_unknown_path_protection call/profile. Original Static, strict MEC, KRS, source contracts and Production remain unchanged.
